corrections.why: The NHLR description says the platform 'is still there' and the FFA Montana list marks it Abandoned. No source read says it is gone.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: NHLR (2022) and firelookout.com say the platform is still there; the FFA Montana list says Abandoned. No newer source found, so the current condition is unconfirmed.

notes_for_editor: The brief's 'gone' is not supported by any source read. The NHLR entry (registered 2022) and the firelookout.com Wisdom page both say the platform is still there; the FFA Montana list says Abandoned. The Forest Lookouts page gives the county, forest and legal location only, and does not say the platform is still there. No staffing, fire or access information was found, so those are omitted. A cabin-rental listing for the Wisdom Ranger District names no lookout. Search snippets about Bender Point and a Facebook post were about other lookouts and were not used.
